entity.description: Dated buying policy of an organization: the buying defaults and the controls of its purchase documents. An empty field takes the built-in default, which is Mantle's behavior with no row: every flag that changes an existing Mantle service is off by default (impl-purchasing §2). Written by mantle.order.PurchaseServices.store#PurchasePolicy, read by get#PurchasePolicy and, with no permission check, by the purchase rules through PurchasePolicy.js's effective().

field.name: currencyUomId
field.description: The currency of a new purchase order when the supplier's profile sets none

field.name: priceListId
field.description: The purchase price list a new order prices from first

field.name: facilityId
field.description: The receiving facility of a new purchase order

field.name: buyerPartyId
field.description: The buyer of a supplier with no buyer of its own (no Buyer-to-Supplier relationship)

field.name: settlementTermId
field.description: The payment term of a supplier whose profile sets none

field.name: incotermEnumId
field.description: The Incoterm (a TermType under TtInco) of a supplier whose profile sets none

field.name: rfqResponseDays
field.description: Days a supplier has to answer an RFQ (7 with no row)

field.name: quoteExpiryWarnDays
field.description: Days before a quote's expiry it shows as expiring (7 with no row)

field.name: reminderDays
field.description: Days after a purchase order is sent that an unacknowledged order is reminded (3 with no row)

field.name: lockSentOrders
field.description: Y: a sent purchase order changes only through a revision (P9); N with no row

field.name: supplierApprovalRequired
field.description: Y: a new supplier's profile starts Pending approval; N with no row

field.name: unapprovedSupplierEnumId
field.description: PurchaseUnapprovedSupplier: what an RFQ or purchase order to a supplier that is not Approved gets, a warning (the default) or a stop

field.name: approvalGateEnabled
field.description: Y: a purchase part reaches Approved only through decide#PurchaseApproval, and check#PurchaseApprovalRequired warns approve#Order and autoApprove#Order (impl-purchasing §2, P3, P4); N with no row, so Mantle's approval is unchanged

field.name: selfApprovalAllowed
field.description: Y: under the approval gate, the user who placed a purchase order may approve it; N with no row
